what: Every point where the mod touches 9 Kings. Exact class/member names are discovered at runtime by reflection against BepInEx's interop assemblies and can be overridden in the mod's hooks.json override file on the player's PC, so a game update never needs a recompile to re-point a hook.

rows.does: Adds the three Bopl blob kings to the selectable roster; picking one swaps the player's ruler to a blob king and applies its passive + starting ability
Injects one extra Bopl ability card drawn from abilities.json pool into the draft; playing it stores the ability for the next battle
Applies battle.json ring-out layer after 9 Kings' own combat math: computes push_tiles, moves units, destroys edge-crossers, checks king_ring_out
Replaces the blob-king's melee/ranged lines with units.json blob troops and tags them with mass + knockback
Reads ability names, descriptions and player colors from {game:custom-bopl-battle}; logs exactly which files it read; mod runs with mechanics intact and names resolved from Bopl's own localization
LAN host/join per multiplayer.json; lockstep of the blob-skirmish round between two players' games
Reads Melty's test seed/checks file, walks king select -> draft -> battle, appends pass/fail per check, writes auto-screenshots
